teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.note: Jacksonville takes the top spot after a 42-7 win over the Colts, up from 5th. The offense (+2.1 points) leads the way, and they're favored by 11.6 at Tennessee in week 10.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.note: Buffalo slips to 2nd despite a 36-10 win over the Ravens and three straight wins. The offense is +4.5 points, and the model likes them 2.5 points more than the betting market does ahead of a trip to Minnesota.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.note: San Francisco sat out a bye week and slid one spot to 3rd at +5.1 points. They're 6-1 and favored by 11.3 at home against the Raiders.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.note: Chicago jumped three spots to 4th after a 34-17 win at Seattle, its third straight. The model rates them 2.7 points higher than the betting market, and they're favored by 5.1 against Tampa Bay.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.note: The Rams beat the Chargers 24-9 but still fell two spots to 5th, partly because injuries cost them 0.7 points. They're 4-4 with a 45 percent shot at the playoffs.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.note: Cincinnati climbed five spots to 6th on a 43-36 shootout win over Tennessee, its third straight. The defense at -0.9 points is the weak spot, while the offense is +1.8.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.note: Kansas City lost 28-24 at Denver yet moved up a spot to 7th. Injuries cost them 0.6 points, and they're favored by 8.9 at home against the Jets.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.note: Minnesota has the best strength of record in the league at rank 1, even after a 19-15 loss at Detroit. The defense is +2.5 points, the offense -2.1, and Buffalo visits in week 9.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.note: New England edged Miami 24-19 and rose a spot to 9th. Injuries took 0.5 points off the rating, and the Packers visit as 4.3-point underdogs.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.note: Detroit beat Minnesota 19-15 for a third straight win but dropped four spots to 10th. Injuries cost them 2.2 points, and the offense is still +2.8.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.note: Tampa Bay shut out Atlanta 16-0 and moved up to 11th at 3-5. The model rates them 4.0 points higher than the betting market does.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.note: Seattle fell eight spots to 12th after a 34-17 home loss to Chicago. The quarterback situation cost 2.1 points, and the model is 3.5 points lower on them than the betting market.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.note: Pittsburgh has won four straight, most recently 27-6 over Cleveland, and jumped five spots to 13th. At 6-2 they have an 82 percent chance at the playoffs.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.note: Green Bay climbed five spots to 14th after a 27-19 win over Carolina. Injuries still cost them 1.5 points this week, and they visit New England as 4.3-point underdogs.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.note: Houston held at 15th through a bye, sitting 2-5 with a 19 percent playoff chance. The model is 4.3 points lower on them than the betting market, even as it favors them by 3.1 at the Chargers.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.note: Denver has won four straight, including 28-24 over Kansas City, and sits 6-2, yet it fell three spots to 16th. The model rates them 2.9 points below the betting market.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.note: Dallas stays 17th after a 33-30 home loss to Arizona. The offense is +2.0 points but the defense is -2.2, and the model has them favored by just 0.4 at Indianapolis.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.note: Atlanta fell two spots to 18th after a 16-0 loss at Tampa Bay. The offense is -2.1 points, and Cincinnati is a 3.9-point favorite in week 9.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.note: Washington beat Philadelphia 27-10 and moved up two spots to 19th. They're 2-4-1, and injuries cost them 0.8 points this week.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.note: Indianapolis has lost four straight, the latest a 42-7 loss to Jacksonville, and is 2-6 with a point differential of -61. They hold 20th at -3.2 points.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.note: Carolina lost 27-19 at Green Bay but still edged up to 21st at 3-4. Injuries cost them 2.0 points this week.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.note: Las Vegas won a 38-33 shootout at the Jets and rose three spots to 22nd. The offense gained 0.6 points, though it's still the weakest unit at -1.3.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.note: New York gave up 38 in a 33-point loss to the Raiders, its third straight, yet still rose four spots to 23rd. The defense at -1.2 points is the weakest unit.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints

teams.name: New York Giants

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.note: The Chargers are 0-7 after a 24-9 loss to the Rams, with a point differential of -76. The offense at -3.5 points is the biggest problem, though they rose two spots to 26th.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.note: Miami lost 24-19 to New England but rose three spots to 27th, helped by +0.8 points from injuries. They're 1-6 and host Detroit as 5.5-point underdogs.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.note: Arizona won 33-30 at Dallas and moved up a spot to 28th. Injuries cost them 1.4 points, and the model has them 9.1-point underdogs at Seattle.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.note: Baltimore plunged 15 spots to 29th after a 36-10 loss at Buffalo, its third straight. The quarterback situation cost 6.5 points, and the model is 5.7 points lower than the betting market.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.note: Tennessee rose two spots to 30th despite a 43-36 loss at Cincinnati. At 1-7 they face Jacksonville as 11.6-point underdogs in week 10.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.note: Philadelphia has lost six straight, the latest 27-10 at Washington, and sits 31st at -7.7 points. Their starter puts them 3.5 points below their usual quarterback situation.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.note: Cleveland drops nine spots to last after a 27-6 loss at Pittsburgh. The quarterback situation cost 2.6 points, and the offense is -2.9 points despite a 5-3 record.
